core_obligations: Choose an affine scheme $U$ with a surjective etale morphism $U \to X$ and note that $U$ is a Noetherian scheme (proof lines 2377-2381).
Observe that the asserted equality of subsheaves holds if and only if it holds after restricting to $U$, since equality of quasi-coherent subsheaves is detected on the cover (proof lines 2383-2384).
Conclude with Artin-Rees for schemes on $U$ (proof lines 2384-2385).
proof_roadmap: The Noetherian affine etale cover (proof lines 2377-2381).
The equality is local for the cover (proof lines 2383-2384).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is Artin-Rees for a coherent sheaf on a Noetherian algebraic space with a quasi-coherent subsheaf and a sheaf of ideals, asserting the existence of a constant past which the two intersections agree (statement lines 2361-2374). The proof reduces to an affine Noetherian scheme etale over the space, observes that the equality is detected after restriction, and quotes the scheme case. The reduction and the locality check are the substance, so the claim is H2.
